_comment: Event definitions. How OFTEN each happens is set per scenario in scenarios.json. All numbers are placeholders, NOT real NASA data.

solar_particle_event.name: Solar particle event
solar_particle_event.warning_text: The Sun just flared! A solar particle event arrives next sol. Build a storm shelter.
solar_particle_event.start_text: A solar particle event is hitting the base. High radiation today.

storm_dose.note: Extra radiation per sol, before the storm shelter cuts it.

dust_storm.name: Dust storm
dust_storm.warning_text: Weather satellites see a dust storm coming. It arrives next sol and will dim the solar panels.
dust_storm.start_text: A dust storm blocks most sunlight. Solar panels make much less power.

lunar_night.name: Lunar night
lunar_night.warning_text: The Sun sets tomorrow. Lunar night means NO solar power. Charge your batteries!
lunar_night.start_text: Lunar night. Solar panels make no power. The base runs on batteries.

duration_min.note: Shortened for the game. A real lunar night lasts about two Earth weeks.

equipment_failure.name: Equipment failure
equipment_failure.start_text: Something broke! One module is offline while the crew repairs it.
